2026 Edition — understand whether your wedding budget is financially comfortable under different guest and ang bao scenarios.
THE PROBLEM

The article gives cost ranges and ang bao norms, but working out YOUR own numbers — what your banquet actually costs with GST and service charge, what you can realistically expect from guests, and whether you would be in surplus or shortfall — still requires tedious calculation. This workbook does it for you, with honest scenario planning.
WHAT THIS WORKBOOK DOES
• INPUTS — guests, tables, package price, service charge, GST, and every non-banquet cost (bridal, photography, videography, décor, rings, attire, invitations, transport, etc.).
• CALCULATOR — total expenditure, three ang bao scenarios (conservative / expected / optimistic), surplus or shortfall for each, and break-even points.
• RESULTS — a dashboard of total budget, banquet vs non-banquet split, expected ang bao, break-even, upfront cash requirement and a payment milestones timeline.
HOW TO USE — 3 STEPS
STEP 1 · Go to INPUTS and enter your real numbers and quotes. Set your three ang bao per-guest assumptions on INPUTS too.
STEP 2 · Review CALCULATOR. See which scenario leaves you short or in surplus, and the break-even ang bao.
STEP 3 · Use RESULTS to build your upfront cash reserve and payment timeline — and never let the budget depend on guests funding it.
WHAT IS ESTIMATED vs OFFICIAL vs PLANNING ASSUMPTION vs MARKET ESTIMATE vs USER INPUT
• Ang bao income is a SCENARIO / estimate — NEVER a guarantee. Treat it as a planning scenario, not a funding source.
• GST rate (9% from 2024) and service-charge practice (typically 10%) are official/venue facts — verify current rates with your venue and IRAS.
• Per-guest ang bao amounts are market estimates you control via the INPUTS assumptions.
• Default non-banquet cost figures (bridal, photography, etc.) are planning assumptions / market estimates — replace with your actual quotes.
LIMITATIONS & DISCLAIMER
This tool is for cashflow planning, not prediction. It does not guarantee any ang bao outcome or any wedding surplus. Confirm GST and service-charge terms with your venue before committing.
Yellow = editable input · Green = auto-calculated · Do not type into green cells.
